scope: Current factual requirements, deterministic quest outcomes, and repeat-use costs for the Lovakengj Minecart Network. This record covers the X Marks the Spot -> Client of Kourend -> The Forsaken Tower chain. It contains no route ordering, utility valuation, or strategy.

source_catalog.used_for: X Marks the Spot start requirements, required spade, fixed rewards, and Client of Kourend prerequisite.
Client of Kourend quest gate, feather transformation, fixed rewards, and Kharedst's memoirs acquisition.
The Forsaken Tower gate, quest inputs, fixed rewards, permanent free minecart use, and Jewellery of jubilation memoir page.
Current per-trip price and the complete list of network destinations.
Memoirs page model and its relationship to Kourend quest rewards.

consumption_or_transformation.spade: Required to dig at clue locations; not consumed. The Eastfloor spade does not work.

items_or_capabilities: Beginner scroll box if the player does not already possess one; it can be claimed later when one was already possessed

unlocks: Eligibility to start Client of Kourend

consumption_or_transformation.feather: Used on Veos's quest-supplied enchanted scroll to create an enchanted quill. The quill and scroll are handed to Veos during the quest; the original feather is therefore not retained.

unlocks: Eligibility to start The Forsaken Tower

consumption_or_transformation.tinderbox: Required during the quest but not identified as consumed; one can be obtained during the quest.

memoirs_page.name: Jewellery of jubilation
memoirs_page.effect: Adds the Lovakengj memoir teleport, which lands north-east of the Lovakengj bank.

fixed_outcomes.other_capability: Ability to recolour graceful outfit pieces in Lovakengj colours.

unlocks: Permanent free use of the Lovakengj Minecart Network

network_access_and_repeat_cost.base_access: The current network has no quest, favour, skill, or one-time-payment requirement to use it before The Forsaken Tower; stations charge per ride until that quest is completed.

before_the_forsaken_tower.coin_condition: The player must have 20 coins in inventory to open the destination interface.

network_access_and_repeat_cost.legacy_context: A historical 100,000-coin unlimited-ride purchase is not a current requirement. Players who made that purchase before the January 2024 change can obtain a 100,000-coin refund from a minecart operator.

kharedsts_memoirs_interaction.direct_relevance: Client of Kourend gives the base Kharedst's memoirs, and The Forsaken Tower adds its Jewellery of jubilation page. The memoir teleport and minecart network are separate transport capabilities: neither is a prerequisite, charge, or replacement for the other.
